summary: Review jurisdiction under Order 47 Rule 1 CPC; error apparent on record standard; High Court erroneously exercised appellate powers during review; discarding survey report in original writ decision reconsidered improperly; Perry Kansagra and Shanti Conductors precedents applied; review invalid when based on mere erroneous merits; rehearing impermissible in review.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court's review order setting aside original writ judgment set aside; status quo ante restored.
